text.p: These are the leading stories in the Malawian press on Thursday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

THE NATION - The opposition Alliance for Democracy (AFORD) party on Wednesday issued a statement backing its member of parliament Kampunga Mwafulirwa who last weekend described President Bakili Muluzi as "a liar" who did not fulfil his promises.
- Twenty-two lecturers have quit their jobs at the University of Malawi after their demands for a 100 per cent pay rise was turned down.

- Vice President of the main opposition Malawi Congress Party Gwanda Chakuamba has written a protest letter to President Bakili Muluzi demanding that his ruling United Democratic Front stops offering financial rewards to senior opposition party officials encouraging them to defect.
